subject.title: fix(channels): honor configured read target policies

question: Should signed message-action context plus `nativeChannelId` and `conversationReadOrigin` become the permanent public Gateway and plugin authorization contract while preserving current-main runtime identity secret handling?
rationale: This determines both provider-access trust semantics and external plugin compatibility, and the security-critical merge conflict cannot choose that product and API boundary mechanically.

options.title: Compose and adopt
options.body: Preserve current-main token handling, add the signed authority context, document its trust semantics, and require final-head compatibility and security proof.

options.title: Keep authority internal
options.body: Preserve current-main identity while passing authorization through narrower internal seams without public plugin authority fields.

options.title: Split the work
options.body: Land channel-local gates separately and defer the signed identity and public API expansion for focused review.

recommendation.title: Compose and adopt
recommendation.body: Preserve current-main token handling, add the signed authority context, document its trust semantics, and require final-head compatibility and security proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and most recently changed the exact current-main signed runtime identity path that must be preserved during this security-boundary decision.
